capabilities: Render a swatch next to CSS colors in inline code
Recognize hex, RGB/RGBA, and HSL/HSLA formats
Switch between swatch box and fully colored badge mode
Skip fenced code blocks and bare hashtags outside backticks
disambiguation: Not a text colorizer; it only adds swatches beside CSS colors that fill an entire inline code span.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual or from source.
intentEvidence: Based on Inline Color Swatch by Suika, released under MIT.
problem: Obsidian shows CSS colors in inline code as plain text, so you cannot see the actual color without leaving the note.

relations.evidence: Based on Inline Color Swatch by Suika, released under MIT.

summary: Color swatch renderer that displays a swatch next to CSS color values (hex, RGB, HSL) written in inline code, in Live Preview and Reading view.
